name: Port Moresby
coordinates_source: WV Papua New Guinea cities list
note: City: the national capital and main gateway to PNG, a destination in its own right with the city's spots around it.

name: Sogeri Plateau
note: Natural area: 600 m plateau 'a popular weekend trip' from Port Moresby, with picnic sites, rapids and walks (Wikipedia article is the town of Sogeri on the plateau).

name: Varirata National Park
note: National park: PNG's first national park, 23 km NE of Port Moresby on the Sogeri Plateau, with lookouts, a lake, trails, birdwatching and picnic areas; admission charged.

name: Varirata Main Lookout
note: Viewpoint: the most popular attraction in Varirata National Park, with views over the Sogeri escarpment, the hills, coastline and Port Moresby.

name: Iarokrai Rapids
note: Campsite and river rapids on the Sogeri Plateau, run by a local family; about two hours' trek on from it reaches a stone-markings site.

name: Crystal Rapids
note: Picnic area on the Sogeri road near Sirinumu Dam; the tourism board's Sogeri story calls it 'overly popular', a weekend picnic and swimming spot.

name: Sirinumu Dam
note: Dam: a reservoir on the Sogeri side of Port Moresby, a starting point for hikes to nearby waterfalls, with kayaking and canoeing, and tilapia farms visitors can tour.

name: Koitaki
note: Village on the Kokoda Track with a country club for trekkers' overnight stays (Post Courier names the club, not a visitor guide).

name: Owers' Corner
note: Memorial: the southern start of the Kokoda Track, with the Kokoda Track Memorial and views over the Owen Stanley Range.

name: Kokoda Track
note: Trail: the 96 km WWII trek over the Owen Stanley Range from Owers' Corner north to the Kokoda Valley, usually 6-12 days (its northern half lies in Oro Province).

name: Efogi
note: Village and WWII battle site on the Kokoda Track in Central Province; Wikipedia only, no visitor guide names a stop here.

name: Eora Creek
note: WWII battle site on the Kokoda Track; Wikipedia only, no visitor guide names a stop here.

name: Port Moresby Nature Park
note: Wildlife and botanical park (formerly the National Capital Botanical Gardens) with tree kangaroos, cassowaries, birds of paradise, a WWII walk-through aviary and gardens.

name: National Museum and Art Gallery
wiki: Papua New Guinea National Museum and Art Gallery
note: Museum: PNG's national museum in Waigani, with carvings, beads, traditional boats, cultural objects and WWII relics outside.

name: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
wiki: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
note: Landmark: the parliament building in Waigani, designed on a Maprik haus tambaran; visitors see the exterior, with guided tours outside sitting days.

name: Bomana War Cemetery
note: War cemetery: the largest WWII Commonwealth cemetery in PNG, 3,824 graves, mostly from the Kokoda campaign; free and open daily, 19 km out of town.

name: Ela Beach
coordinates_source: WV Port Moresby listing geo (Ela Beach Craft Market point on the beach; no OSM "Ela Beach" feature found, check)
note: Beach: the revitalised waterfront in central Port Moresby, a paved promenade for walks and sunsets, with weekend markets and cultural events (not a swimming beach).

name: APEC Haus
note: Building: the APEC summit venue on Ela Beach, styled on a Hiri lagatoi crab-claw sail; a landmark to see from the beach, public access unconfirmed.

name: Touaguba Hill
note: Viewpoint: a hill above the city centre with a view over the centre and the ocean; the residential area of the ambassadors' residences.

name: Moitaka Wildlife Sanctuary
note: Wildlife sanctuary: a crocodile and bird sanctuary on the Sir Hubert Murray Highway, with some very large crocodiles.

name: Port Moresby Golf Club
note: Golf course: a club course opposite the government buildings, open to visitors, with a restaurant in the clubhouse (a private operator).

name: Atama Beach
note: Beach: a beach at Pari on Taurama Road, with a hiking route, open 24 hours and free.

name: Taurama Aquatic and Indoor Centre
note: Sports complex: a modern aquatic centre opened in 2015, with 25 m and 50 m outdoor pools and indoor courts, popular with locals.

name: Adventure Park PNG
note: Family amusement park at 14 Mile, outside the city, with a Ferris wheel, water slides, paddle boats, a small zoo, lakes and gardens.

name: Gordons Market
coordinates_source: photon OSM amenity=marketplace "Gordons Market" (resolver LOW, hand-graded; verify)
note: Market: a daily city market in Gordons with produce, betel nut, crafts and bilums; best visited in the morning with a guide.

name: Boroko Market
coordinates_source: photon OSM amenity=marketplace "Boroko Market" (resolver LOW, hand-graded; verify)
note: Market: a daily city market in Boroko with fresh produce, tropical fruit, crafts and bilums; best visited in the morning with a guide.

name: Ela Beach Craft Market
note: Market: a craft market run by Ela Murray International School on the last Saturday of each month, with carvings, baskets and other PNG handicrafts.

name: Moresby Arts Theatre Craft Market
note: Market: a monthly craft market held by the Moresby Arts Theatre (once a month, not a daily place).

name: Hiri Moale Festival
note: Festival: an annual event on PNG's Independence Day weekend in mid-September, with a race of lakatoi canoes that leaves from Ela Beach (an event, not a permanent place).

name: Hanuabada
note: Village: a coastal Motu Hiri village in Port Moresby; Wikivoyage lists the 'Hiri villages' among the city's points of interest.

name: Port Moresby Reef and Wreck Dive Sites
note: Dive sites: reefs and wrecks close to Port Moresby, reached by day boat or from Loloata Island; a group of sites, not one place.

name: Loloata Island
coordinates_source: photon OSM leisure=resort "Loloata Island Resort" (the visitor point on the island; resolver LOW, verify)
note: Island: a private island resort in Bootless Inlet, 20-30 minutes by boat from Port Moresby, with snorkelling, diving, kayaks and day visits.

name: Motupore Island
coordinates_source: photon OSM place=islet "Motupore Island" (resolver LOW, verify)
note: Island: a research island in Bootless Inlet with a University of PNG research station and coral reefs; no visitor source names a stop here.

name: Bootless Inlet
note: Bay: a sheltered inlet 20 km SE of Port Moresby, protected by a barrier reef, with four islands (Motupore, Loloata, Manunouha, Bunamotu); Wikipedia only.

name: Redscar Bay
note: Bay: a 6.4 km bay NW of Port Moresby with a coral reef and WWII aircraft crash sites near the old Rogers Airfield; Wikipedia and Pacific Wrecks only.

name: Hiritano Highway
note: Road: the roughly 300 km highway from Port Moresby through Central Province to Kerema, about four hours' drive (the drive, not a stop).

name: Kerema
note: Town: the capital of Gulf Province on the Gulf of Papua coast, a basic base for the Gulf with a few hotels, reached by the Hiritano Highway or by air.

name: Kikori
note: Town: a small fishing centre on the Kikori River delta, a good birdwatching base with Delta Lodge.

name: Lakekamu Basin
note: Wilderness: a 2,500 sq km lowland rainforest and river basin in Gulf Province, known for cassowaries, crowned pigeons, palm cockatoos and birds of paradise; reached by charter or specialist tour.

name: Bulldog Track
note: Trek: a 60 km foot track over the western end of the Owen Stanley Range, from the Lakekamu River side to Wau; the tourism board's Gulf page calls it a must-see.
